entries.role: Shuttle anatomy and seated bobbin; not used to date the pictured object. Period-compatible simplified wooden shuttle plus plain cloth.
Four-spindle powered water frame. Rejected hand-cranked spinning Jenny for this technology, whose description explicitly refers to powered machinery. No display case or label copied.
Reference for early powered weaving anatomy, not a claim that the depicted reconstruction exactly matches the first 1785 loom. Museum display plinth excluded.
